settings.title: Settings
settings.match_size: Match original model size on reimport
settings.match_size.tooltip:
Uniformly rescales the imported model so its overall size matches the original mesh it replaces.
Use it when a GLB carries an unintended export scale (e.g. a Blender node scale) and enters the game too big or too small.
Proportions are preserved.
settings.normalize_facial_bones.tooltip:
Allows character-specific face bones with the same role to be retargeted by suffix, for example bigby_mouthCorner_L to rhys_mouthCorner_L.
This can help compatible face rigs follow target lipsync, but can deform mismatched mouths. Off keeps each game's default safe behavior.
settings.anti_aliasing.tooltip:
Renders the model preview at 2x resolution and downsamples it for smoother triangle edges.
This is preview-only and may be slower on very large meshes.
settings.flight_camera.tooltip:
Switches the preview from orbit-style navigation to a free-flight camera.
Left-drag looks around; W/S dolly, A/D strafe, Q/E move vertically. Shift moves faster, Ctrl slower.
settings.discord_presence.tooltip: Shows the selected game and currently opened .d3dmesh/combined model in your Discord activity.

credits.title: Credits
credits.paragraph: Without their analysis and the documentation available in their repositories, none of this would have happened. I would like to thank them for supporting the community, creating tools, and documenting the formats. Their work made it possible to build an editor capable of both extracting assets from the game and reinserting them back into it.
credits.special_thanks: And a very special thank you to {0} and {1} for their incredible games and their dedication to these wonderful experiences. Without them, we would never have these models to view, edit, and extract. This is a heartfelt tribute for creating such amazing games that helped shape video game culture.
